description: Adapted from https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/22870-caddy/ revision 3 (bcyran). Prometheus only. Traffic panels measure reverse_proxy routes once, excluding metrics scrapes, redirects and access-denied responses before proxying. Host filter selects the HTTP virtual host. Availability means metrics scrape health, not an external HTTPS probe. Requires Caddy per_host metrics. No active upstream health checks are configured.

panels.description: Prometheus scrape health. Does not test DNS, TLS or public reachability.
